POST /provisioning/accounts.title: Create a merchant account
POST /provisioning/accounts.description: Create a merchant account for agent-driven onboarding. body: email, full_name, terms_accepted_at (ISO 8601), terms_version, optional preferred_language. Leave password out: the response then includes claim_url. Send this link to the human; they set their own password there and own the account. Poll status for human_claimed. Only pass password if the human explicitly gave you one.

POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId.title: Upload a KYC document
POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId.description: Upload a KYC/identity document (ID, business registration, proof of address) for a merchant's onboarding. Pass the merchantId and the document; submit required documents before calling onboarding/complete.

POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId.title: Extract onboarding data
POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId.description: Auto-extract onboarding details from the merchant's website or uploaded documents to pre-fill their profile. Pass the merchantId; review the extracted fields before completing onboarding.

GET /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}.title: Get onboarding status
GET /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}.description: Return the merchant's onboarding progress plus KYC, verification state, and human_claimed. While human_claimed is false the response re-issues claim_url: send it to the human. Poll this to see what remains before calling onboarding/complete or request_live.

POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId.title: Request live mode activation
POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId.description: Ask to move the merchant from TEST to LIVE. Returns merchant_approval_path (the human approves on the dashboard) and human_claimed. If human_claimed is false, send claim_url to the human first, then merchant_approval_path. Live secret keys are never returned here; the human reads them in the dashboard.
